name: Article 5, § 5 – 69
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: 5. The public interface shall ensure the automatic deletion of the information related to a posting which has been submitted through that public interface 36 months after the end date of the posting period. The retention period shall not be extended at Union level. This shall be without prejudice to the right of Member States to retain information in their national systems for longer periods where necessary and justified under national law and in compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679.
